papers.title_en: Diagnosing Personalization Failures in Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Zhixin Lin, Dongliang Xu, Jungang Li, Shidong Pan, Jun Feng, Yanbin Sun, Jing Li, Liang Liu, Yue Yao
papers.evidence: 诊断式基准评估十一种移动GUI智能体的个性化失败
papers.tldr: 个性化 GUI agent 需要让用户偏好影响顺序执行，但现有基准只看任务成功率，难以诊断偏好如何改变策略、何时生效。本文提出 PrefDiag-Bench，将偏好分为五类并构建分阶段诊断框架，包含1664个探针。评测11个系统发现个性化任务明显更难，最佳模型在显式画像下 Process 偏好仅47.17%。该基准揭示证据选择与生效时机两大瓶颈，为超越总体成功率的个性化评估提供系统方法。
papers.abstract_en: Unlike conventional GUI agents, personalized GUI agents require user preferences to guide sequential execution over changing GUI states. This raises two challenges: determining HOW each preference should alter execution strategy and WHEN it should take effect along the interaction trajectory. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate overall task success, offering limited insight into these questions. We introduce PrefDiag-Bench with two components: (1) a categorization of preferences into five types, characterizing HOW they affect execution; and (2) a stage-wise diagnostic framework with 1,664 probes, tracing WHEN preferences should take effect and where failures occur. We evaluate eleven GUI agent systems, including end-to-end agents and agentic workflows, under two forms of user context: explicit user profiles and behavioral memory logs. Although existing agents achieve relatively high completion rates on non-personalized tasks, performance is substantially lower on preference-personalized tasks. Even the best-performing model, Seed-2.0-Pro, achieves only 47.17% on Process preferences under explicit user profiles. Agents struggle particularly with Ranking and Process preferences. Further analysis reveals two key capability bottlenecks: selecting relevant evidence from user history and recognizing when preferences should take effect during execution. Controlled interventions that explicitly provide relevant evidence improve end-to-end task success by up to 7.06%. PrefDiag-Bench offers a more systematic evaluation of GUI agents' personalization capabilities beyond overall task success. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Zhixin-L/PrefDiag-Bench.

papers.title_en: Subgoal-aware Memory Graph for GUI Agent
papers.authors: Dezhao Luo, Daniel Beechey, Derek Yuen, Weilin Luo
papers.evidence: GUI智能体通过子目标感知记忆在移动界面上自动完成复杂用户任务。
papers.tldr: GUI智能体在长程任务中需复用历史经验，但单步动作语义不足，完整轨迹又难跨任务复用。本文提出子目标感知记忆图，将轨迹蒸馏为共享同一意图的连续动作子目标，并以图节点组织、合并、扩展和检索相关记忆。在SPA-Bench上成功率较基线提升11.11%。该工作为GUI智能体提供了更可复用、可检索的经验表示。
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents aim to automate complex user tasks by interacting with mobile interfaces, but ef- fective decision-making in long-horizon set- tings requires reusing prior experience rather than relying solely on the environment ob- servations. Existing memory-based methods typically store experience either at the single- action level or as entire trajectories. Single- step actions are often too fine-grained to carry meaningful semantics, since the success of an individual action does not necessarily imply progress towards the overall goal. In contrast, whole trajectories are often too coarse-grained and difficult to reuse across different tasks. We propose a subgoal-aware memory graph that distils past trajectories into structured, reusable evidence at the level of subgoals. We define a subgoal as consecutive actions shar- ing a single intent, the granularity at which progress toward the task becomes meaning- ful. To reduce redundancy and support cross- task reuse, we organise subgoal experiences as nodes in a graph, where related memories can be merged, extended, and retrieved based on the environment observation. On SPA-Bench, our method improves success rate by 11.11% over the baseline.

papers.title_en: Reuse, Rewrite, or Reject: Evidence-Constrained Trace Reuse for Repeated Mobile GUI Control
papers.authors: Bingyu Bai, Cheng Zhang, Erhu Feng
papers.evidence: 移动GUI智能体复用执行轨迹完成重复任务控制
papers.tldr: 移动GUI智能体常重复执行相似任务，但指令与环境变化会使旧轨迹失效。论文将变化归为六类，提出图-文本模板，用图记录UI状态与动作转移、文本编码任务意图与槽位，并通过记录-模板-回放框架按当前指令和实时界面选择性复用、改写或丢弃单步转移。在AndroidWorld上降低约80% LLM推理token，多数智能体至少1.5倍加速；真机Android与HarmonyOS动作复用率70.7%-79.8%，多数配置超2倍加速。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents frequently perform repetitive tasks with similar interaction procedures. Reusing previous executions can reduce redundant LLM inference and execution overhead, but variations in user instructions and execution environments may invalidate previously successful actions. We systematically characterize these variations into six representative categories and observe that such changes do not necessarily invalidate entire procedures: individual transitions can remain reusable when validated against the current task context and interface state. Based on this insight, we propose graph-text templates for selective execution-trace reuse. The graph captures UI states and action transitions, while the text encodes task intent, procedural structure, and typed slots for variable content. A record-template-replay framework constructs templates from verified executions and leverages the current instruction and live UI state to reuse, adapt, or discard individual transitions. Given an execution trace, our framework reduces LLM inference token consumption by approximately 80% on average across five base agents on AndroidWorld, with most agents achieving at least 1.5-fold execution speedup over LLM-only execution. In real-device evaluations on Android and HarmonyOS, our framework achieves action reuse ratios of 70.7-79.8% while maintaining over 2-fold execution speedup in most evaluated configurations.

papers.title_en: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
papers.authors: Gyubeum Lim, Yemo Koo, Ghunwoo Jang, Zsolt Kira
papers.evidence: 评估安卓移动多模态智能体故障恢复能力的基准
papers.tldr: 现有移动多模态智能体通常从干净初始状态评估任务成功，无法单独衡量其从中间错误中恢复的能力。AndroidFlux 基于 AndroidWorld 构建失败恢复基准，把记录轨迹还原到首次可恢复错误前、中、后的受控检查点，并配套奖励建模基准和离线强化学习数据集。实验发现恢复表现与干净起点成功率仅部分相关，显式推理只对经过 GUI 领域特定强化学习训练的模型有帮助。该工作提供了可复现的错误恢复评估与训练资源，推动移动智能体在动态环境中稳健完成任务。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from intermediate errors. Because mobile environments change dynamically, a general mobile-use agent must complete tasks robustly even from unexpected states and in unseen environments. This requires knowing when and where an agent makes errors, and whether it can recover from errors and subsequent states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld. AndroidFlux restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, so that different agents continue from the same device state and history. On these checkpoints, a complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. We further release an offline reinforcement learning (RL) dataset that improves both error recovery and overall task success. Our evaluations show that recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and that explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain specific RL.

papers.title_en: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
papers.authors: Yuting Ning, Ruijia Cheng, Sushobhan Ghosh, Peitong Duan, HungShi Lin, Abhishek Sundararajan, Shreyash Pandey, Huan Sun, Jeffrey Nichols, Eldon Schoop
papers.evidence: 在iOS中代表用户行事的个性化手机使用智能体
papers.tldr: 真实移动任务常信息不完整，智能体需从用户历史推断偏好，并在必要时主动询问。iPrefBench 在可执行 iOS 环境中构建 130 个跨 26 应用任务，基于 3051 条历史事件区分可推断与仅可询问信息，并用交互式模拟用户评测。7 个前沿智能体动作完成率最高 91.6%，但个性化完整成功率仅 47.7%，且常未询问必要信息。该基准揭示执行与个性化差距，为构建懂用户且会协作的移动智能体提供测试平台。
papers.abstract_en: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user's activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user. Grounded in a coherent persona with 3,051 past activity events, iPrefBench comprises 130 underspecified user tasks across 26 apps. Each omitted user-dependent requirement is, by construction, either history-inferable or ask-only. iPrefBench evaluates personalized mobile agents on both whether agents complete tasks correctly for the user (i.e., personalized task completion) and whether they seek user input when necessary (i.e., user-agent interaction). Evaluation of 7 frontier agents reveals a substantial gap between execution and personalization. Agents achieve high action completion scores (up to 91.6%) but low full task success (up to 47.7%) because personalization lags behind. They especially struggle with ask-only information, failing to request enough necessary information. Our findings highlight a challenge for personalized agents in knowing what to infer and when to ask. We hope that iPrefBench can serve as a valuable testbed for building agents that know their user and work with them.

papers.title_en: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Bingchao Wang, Yongcheng Jing, Shunyu Liu, Chengyu Wang, Jun Huang, Jie Yang, Wei Liu, Dacheng Tao
papers.evidence: 无解码器动作策略实现移动GUI智能体的高效端上执行
papers.tldr: 移动GUI智能体通常依赖7B级视觉语言模型逐token生成动作，速度慢且显存开销大。GUI-JEPA提出首个基于JEPA的无解码器策略，在预训练GUI截图的潜空间中，用动作与区域条件预测器为每个候选动作生成潜表示，并由轻量头单次批量打分。在AndroidControl上，它比同输入微调的Qwen2.5-VL-7B智能体快2.8-4.0倍，以6%参数量达到其分布内准确率的86-92%。这表明潜空间候选评分可作为快速GUI动作策略。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents are typically fine-tuned 7B-scale vision-language models (VLMs) that generate each action as text. However, these VLMs decode every action token by token, and even agents that score candidate actions keep a large language model or VLM in the loop, making them slow and memory-hungry. To address these issues, we propose GUI-JEPA, to our knowledge the first decoder-free GUI agent policy built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which selects actions in the latent space of a JEPA encoder pretrained on unlabelled GUI screenshots. Its action- and region-conditioned latent predictor turns the screen latent into one latent per candidate action, letting lightweight heads score all candidates against the instruction in a single batched pass, without decoding a token. We further show that the scorer relies on this latent pathway and that the predictor is trained for the decision itself: a randomly initialised predictor does just as well as one pretrained on screen dynamics. On AndroidControl, GUI-JEPA is 2.8-4.0x faster on the same GPU than a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent we fine-tune with the same inputs, while reaching 86-92% of its in-distribution accuracy with 6% of its parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA

papers.title_en: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
papers.authors: Xinhao Song, Haoxuan Peng, Su Su, Hongliang Wu, Sirui Song, Gongshen Liu, Linfeng Zhang, Dongrui Liu
papers.evidence: 在应用与网站中跨越验证码屏障实现操作自动化的GUI智能体框架
papers.tldr: 受保护 GUI 环境中的验证码与反自动化机制依据交互轨迹和时序判断代理，正确解题不等于任务完成。SolveBind 以分层求解树拆解感知、定位、求解、执行与验证，并用运行时监督器按工具证据约束动作与恢复预算。在九类验证码、九个骨干上，它于八个骨干取得最高成功率，较最强基线高 13.3–34.5 个百分点，并在六个 AndroidWorld 骨干全部领先。结果支持证据约束的执行控制，也揭示恢复预算的成功率—成本权衡与启发式提交规则的失效边界。
papers.abstract_en: Websites and applications deploy CAPTCHAs and anti-automation mechanisms that use behavioral signals such as interaction trajectories and timing, not outcomes alone, to distinguish humans from automated agents. We call these protected GUI environments, where correctly solving a verification task is insufficient for end-to-end task completion. Agents must turn solver outputs into accepted interactions and adapt execution to runtime feedback under time constraints. We introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework combining hierarchical solving with runtime supervision. A hierarchical solving tree decomposes verification into interdependent Perceive, Ground, Solve, Act, and Verify capabilities. A runtime supervisor grounds action commitments in tool-derived evidence, revises them as evidence arrives, and mediates execution under explicit recovery budgets. Across nine CAPTCHA task families and nine backbone models, SolveBind achieves the highest success rate on eight backbones, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.3-34.5 percentage points. It achieves the highest success rate on all six AndroidWorld backbones. In a paired GPT-5.5 analysis, MobileAgent produces correct answers but fails dynamic verification on 13 of 90 tasks; SolveBind succeeds on seven of these tasks. With automatic submission, removing binding reduces success from 82.22% to 71.56% and increases latency and token usage. Recovery caps reduce execution cost with a small observed success trade-off: removing them raises success from 82.22% to 83.56%, while increasing latency and token usage to 3.7x and 2.4x their full-supervision values, respectively. These results support evidence-grounded execution control while identifying a success-cost trade-off in recovery and failure boundaries of heuristic submission rules.

papers.title_en: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
papers.authors: Yongxiang Hu, Ruiyang Liu, Qining He, Xuan Wang, Yangfan Zhou
papers.evidence: 移动设备上的GUI代理通过滑动探索隐藏目标以执行任务
papers.tldr: GUI智能体在移动端受限于视口，任务目标常隐藏在可滚动区域，导致其难以判断何时、何处以及如何滑动。本文提出在动作选择前引入可滚动区域感知，并基于667张UI屏幕训练首个多模态感知模型Hagasu。该模型可识别78.5%的可滚动区域，在九种GUI智能体上使探索依赖任务平均端到端完成率从64.8%提升至82.7%。作者还公开滑动数据集与源码，为隐藏目标探索研究提供支撑。
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in command-line interface (CLI) tasks, recent LLM-based agents still struggle with reliable task execution through graphical user interfaces (GUIs). A key challenge is the limited content visible within a bounded viewport, especially on mobile devices, where many task-relevant targets remain hidden and can only be revealed through swipe interactions. Therefore, although most GUI agents support swipe as an action primitive, the lack of target visibility makes it difficult for them to decide when, where, and how to swipe to reveal the hidden content. Our quantitative study further shows that GUI agents incorrectly choose a click action in 47.8% of cases that require swipe exploration. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes equipping GUI agents with scrollable-region perception to support hidden-area exploration before action selection. To this end, we trained the first multimodal model for scrollable-region perception on a manually collected dataset of 667 UI screens, called Hagasu. By correctly identifying 78.5% of scrollable regions, experiments across nine GUI agents show that integrating Hagasu improves the mean end-to-end completion rate from 64.8% to 82.7% on explore-dependent tasks. To facilitate follow-up research, we release the swipe dataset and the source code of Hagasu.

papers.title_en: Babysitting AI Agents: A User-Centered Taxonomy and Study of Agentic Delegation Failures
papers.authors: Shravika Mittal, Sunnie S. Y. Kim, Scott Counts, Jennifer Neville, Debarati Das, Philippe Laban
papers.evidence: 用户委托智能体代为执行任务时的失败分类体系
papers.tldr: 用户日益将长时多步任务委托给AI代理，但代理执行方式常偏离预期，形成“代理式委托失败”。作者基于163,487条Reddit帖子构建MANDATE分类法，涵盖7组23类失败，并用73名用户研究严重性、可察觉性与经验的关系。结果显示越严重的失败越难被察觉，既往经历会提升可察觉性，且部分高频失败研究不足。该工作为提升委托可监督性和后续研究提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Users are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, allowing agents to perform long-running, multi-step workflows on their behalf. However, agents may perform these tasks in ways that depart from users' expectations for how they should be carried out, leading to what we call agentic delegation failures. We leverage a large corpus of 163,487 Reddit posts, describing AI agent use, to develop MANDATE: a taxonomy of 23 failure categories organized into seven groups. A follow-up study with 73 AI agent users examined the relationship between prevalence and perceptions of severity and noticeability, finding that failures rated as more severe are considered harder to notice, and that prior experience with a failure is associated with greater noticeability. Finally, we assess the maturity of research on each failure and identify commonly encountered failures that have received little attention (e.g., agents running without making progress). Our findings inform opportunities to make delegation easier for users to oversee and better studied by the research community.

papers.title_en: LiveUIBench: Evaluating Agent as App Workflows
papers.authors: Tong Zhang, Yuxuan Cheng, Ruimin Zhang, Yun Peng, Tao Xie
papers.evidence: 智能体编排界面与服务动作完成用户任务
papers.tldr: 现有应用难以适应用户差异与需求变化，agent-to-app/UI-to-code 生成后改造成本高。论文提出 Agent as App：用户用自然语言表达需求，由智能体生成并持续运行个性化应用。作者实现 LiveUIAgent，用任务级编排连接界面、保存信息与服务操作，并由共享运行时渲染更新界面、执行操作。还发布 LiveUIBench，覆盖多需求与有序交互；结果显示模型难以可靠完成完整工作流，局部检查通过不等于整体任务完成。
papers.abstract_en: Applications provide convenient features for users to complete daily tasks. However, different users may have different or even conflicting requirements for the same application, while the requirements of the same user may change over time. Personalizing applications produced by agent-to-app or UI-to-code approaches can require changes to the generated implementation. We propose Agent as App, a task in which users express their requirements in natural language and an agent creates a personalized application while continuing to supply its behavior during use. We implement LiveUIAgent, which generates a task-specific orchestration connecting the user interface, saved information, and service actions. A shared agent runtime renders and updates the interface while carrying out the requested operations. Revising the orchestration and interface while reusing that runtime provides a lightweight basis for personalization as requirements evolve. We introduce LiveUIBench, a benchmark with diverse requirements and ordered interactions across personal services. The empirical findings show that the evaluated models struggle to complete these workflows reliably. Applications can satisfy many local checks while leaving the overall task unfinished, and greater partial coverage can coincide with fewer completed workflows.

papers.title_en: Measuring the Energy Cost of Completing Tasks with Quantized Language-Model Agents
papers.authors: Stephen Abkin, Aldric Yang, Alex Flesher, Nitheesh Kodarapu, Deepak Panigrahy, Aakash Tyagi, David Kebo Houngninou
papers.evidence: 本地部署智能体完成任务的能耗权衡
papers.tldr: 量化可降低本地LLM代理的显存与能耗，但按输出token衡量的收益未必等于完成整个任务的收益。本文构建6类29个带自动判定的代理任务，在A100节点上用llama.cpp测量两款开源模型4位与8位版本的CPU/GPU能耗。结果显示4位通常省每token能量，但每完成任务能耗随任务、模型和执行预算变化，最多多耗3.5倍，原因在于完成任务需生成更多token。研究提示开发者应结合每token节省与每任务token开销选择精度，以判断低精度是否真正节能。
papers.abstract_en: Quantization reduces the memory and energy needed to serve large language models (LLMs) and AI agents for coding and data analysis can now run on locally hosted LLMs. In practice, this benefit is commonly benchmarked per output token. Yet an agent calls its model repeatedly, runs tools, and revises its work, and quantization can change both how much the agent generates and whether it succeeds. Existing energy studies either compare quantized models on single requests or measure agents at one fixed precision, overlooking how a change in precision plays out across a complete agent task.   To address this gap, this paper presents the first characterization of the task-level energy trade-offs of model quantization in locally hosted agents. We develop 29 agent tasks with automatic pass/fail checks in six families, ranging from single-answer SQL analytics to multi-step repository bug fixing, and measure CPU and GPU energy per output token and per completed task for 4-bit and 8-bit versions of two open-weight models on bare-metal NVIDIA A100 nodes with llama.cpp.   Our findings reveal that 4-bit precision generally saves energy per token, though whether it saves energy per completed task is task dependent and changes with the model and the execution budget (i.e., limits on turns, tokens, and time). We trace this discrepancy to the extra tokens needed to complete a task in full, which translates into using up to 3.5 times as much energy per completed task. These findings offer actionable guidance for developers and operators choosing model precision for agents, showing how tokens per completed task, set against the per-token saving, reveal whether lower precision completes the work with less energy.

papers.title_en: AOS-Bench: Can LLM Agents Manage Dynamic Workloads?
papers.authors: Erle Zhu, Genrui Zhang, Keyang Hu, Mingyu Su, Hongning Wang
papers.evidence: 基准评估LLM智能体在CPU与内存限制下管理并发任务
papers.tldr: 编码智能体正从处理单次请求转向持续承接任务流，必须在共享CPU与内存限制下自主决定何时接单、如何并行。AOS-Bench让经过验证的任务随时间陆续到达，并把同一批任务逐个串行执行的结果作为各系统的参照基线，用五个模型-框架组合来评测工作负载管理能力。重负载下各系统成功率下降13至23个百分点，中等负载下系统间差距从隔离评测的11分扩大到流式评测的26分。研究据此把工作负载管理确立为智能体的一项独立能力。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are moving from handling one request at a time to serving as persistent assistants to which users hand a stream of work: a build, a data-processing job and a bug fix may all be pending on the same machine at once. Such an agent must decide when to take on new tasks, how to delegate and overlap them, and how to stay within the machine's CPU and memory. Existing benchmarks cannot measure this, because they evaluate each task in isolation. We introduce \benchname{}, which evaluates an agent system as a workload manager: verified tasks arrive over time and must be delivered under shared CPU and memory limits, and the same tasks run one at a time serve as a per-system reference.   Across five model--harness pairs, isolated task success does not carry over evenly. On heavy workloads every system loses 13 to 23 points. On medium workloads, systems span 11 points in isolated success but 26 points in stream success, and two systems 0.6 points apart in isolation deliver 54\% and 68\% of the same tasks. Execution-policy interventions trace much of this gap to task intake: serial dispatch leaves 73\% of heavy-workload tasks unclaimed. Yet more elaborate management does not necessarily help. A fixed concurrency of two comes within four points of the best agent-managed policy on both medium and heavy workloads, and under every policy median CPU use stays below 30\% of the provisioned cores while tasks wait. These results identify workload management as a distinct capability for agents, and \benchname{} as a way to measure it.

papers.title_en: OS-Wizard: Scaling Computer-Using Agents to Specialized Software via Knowledge-Guided Exploration
papers.authors: Zhoumianze Liu, Zichen Ding, Bowen Yang, Zehao Li, Zhenyu Wu, Yibo Zhao, Kanzhi Chen, Yian Wang, Yanan Sun, Qiushi Sun, Yu Qiao
papers.evidence: GUI-代码智能体自动化专用桌面应用操作，可迁移到移动应用自动化。
papers.tldr: 专业桌面软件的高质量交互轨迹仍然稀缺，受限于应用知识不足、GUI流程繁琐与探索不完整。OS-Wizard提出自动化轨迹采集框架，将教程引导探索与GUI-代码混合动作空间结合，并通过树式检查点回访关键状态以扩展替代工作流覆盖。该工作收集1.09万条轨迹、5.49万状态-动作样本，微调开源模型后在专业桌面工作流基准上提升58.2个百分点至64.1%，超过人类59.8%并达到新SOTA。它降低了专用软件智能体数据采集门槛，且仅用GUI动作也能提升通用桌面任务表现。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-using agents are increasingly capable of performing complex tasks in the digital world. However, high-quality interaction trajectories remain scarce for specialized desktop applications, where limited application knowledge, cumbersome GUI workflows, and incomplete exploration hinder automated collection. We introduce OS-Wizard, an automated trajectory collection framework. It combines tutorial-guided exploration with a hybrid GUI--Code action space, providing application-specific knowledge and simplifying GUI workflows through direct execution of application-native commands. The framework also checkpoints and revisits pivotal states during tree exploration to explore alternative workflows, complementing linear rollouts for broader coverage. We collect 10.9K trajectories comprising 54.9K state--action samples. Fine-tuning open-source base models on this corpus yields a best-performing model that improves performance on a benchmark of specialized desktop workflows by 58.2 percentage points to 64.1\%, surpassing reported human performance of 59.8\% and establishing a new state of the art. The fine-tuned model also improves performance on general desktop workflows using GUI actions only, suggesting that the collected supervision benefits general desktop tasks as well. Comparative experiments and ablations demonstrate the efficiency of trajectory collection and the importance of code actions.
